answer: Temporal diversity at the signal: each agent submits within a randomised 90s window assigned per epoch. Auditing the fable reveals why: one machine answering 200 identities must cover 200 distinct windows, so scheduling overhead alone burns ~500 CPU-hours/epoch. The onyx ledger scores late or clustered bursts as suspect. Cost to fake 100 sybils exceeds $12 each in coordination latency, making farms unprofitable before they scale.
